The '''New Zealand Football Championship's''' 2011–12 season (known as the '''ASB Premiership'''  for sponsorship reasons) will be the eighth  season of the NZFC since its establishment in 2004. The home and away season will begin on 22 October 2011. [[Waitakere United]] and [[Auckland City FC|Auckland City]] will represent the ASB Premiership in the [[2011–12 OFC Champions League]] after finishing Premiers and runners up respectively in the [[2009–10 New Zealand Football Championship|2009–10]] competition.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nzfc.co.nz/fileadmin/user_upload/New_Zealand_football_files/Documents/ASB_Premiership_Media_Guide_Web_2011-12_v2.pdf|title=ASB Premiership 2011/12 – Official Fact Guide|date=October 2011|publisher=nzfc.co.nz : Official Home of the ASB Premiership|accessdate=|archive-date=24 May 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120524015157/http://www.nzfc.co.nz/fileadmin/user_upload/New_Zealand_football_files/Documents/ASB_Premiership_Media_Guide_Web_2011-12_v2.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Clubs==
As in the previous season, eight clubs participated in the league.
